serviceName: ISSUANCE OF MEDICAL CERTIFICATE AND CLINICAL ABSTRACT
description: Provision of certified medical certificates, clinical abstracts, and verification of hospital confinements or consultations for employment, legal, insurance, financial assistance, or continuing medical care purposes.
office: Health Information Management Department (HIMD) / Outpatient Department (OPD)
whoMayAvail: All discharged inpatients, active outpatients, or their officially authorized representative requesting certified copies of hospital records and medical abstracts.
feesToBePaid: ₱50.00 (Official Certification Fee; indigent patients waived upon Medical Social Service endorsement)
processingTime: 30 Minutes (Upon submission of complete documentary requirements)
requirements: 1. Valid Government ID • 2. OPD / Hospital Record Card • 3. Authorization Letter (if representative)
processOverview: Step 1: Verification (5m) • Step 2: Payment (5m) • Step 3: Physician Signature (15m) • Step 4: Releasing (5m)
